title: Dinosaur in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ee08a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3fbf5e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#eaffd8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#bfe8a0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scarf' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff7a8a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e03b57'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 76 Q4 72 8 54 Q18 62 28 66 Z' fill='#4fca6a'/>
  <path d='M18 68 Q10 64 11 58 Q17 62 22 65 Z' fill='#8bef9e'/>

  <!-- back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='82' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#2f9e4c'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#46b862'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='22' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='15' ry='13' fill='url(#belly)'/>

  <!-- front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='84' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3fbf5e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='89' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#7ee08a'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M58 48 Q60 34 66 30 L76 36 Q70 44 70 50 Z' fill='#4fca6a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#7ee08a'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='36' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#8bef9e'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <path d='M80 28 Q94 28 94 34 Q94 39 80 39 Z' fill='#5fd47a'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='32' rx='2' ry='1.6' fill='#2f9e4c'/>
  <path d='M81 38 Q88 41 93 37' stroke='#c8f5c0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='25' r='4.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='25' r='2.4' fill='#1d4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M40 46 L44 38 L48 46 Z' fill='#ffd95e'/>
  <path d='M48 44 L53 35 L57 44 Z' fill='#ffd95e'/>

  <!-- arm -->
  <path d='M62 58 Q70 58 72 64 Q66 66 62 64 Z' fill='#5fd47a'/>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M56 46 Q64 52 76 48 Q78 54 74 56 Q62 58 55 52 Z' fill='url(#scarf)'/>
  <path d='M58 52 Q54 62 58 70 L64 68 Q60 60 64 54 Z' fill='#ff8a99'/>
  <path d='M58 56 L64 56 M59 61 L64 60 M60 65 L65 64' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
